# Research Pre-Scope — eic.ec.europa.eu (EIC funding opportunities, lead: EIC Accelerator)

**Generated:** 2026-06-07 (auto-generated by research/scripts/website-prescope.mjs, then scoped by orchestrator)
**Source:** https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-funding-opportunities/eic-accelerator_en
**Generator:** research/scripts/website-prescope.mjs + manual scoping pass
**Proposed domain:** eic-accelerator

## Sub-agent selection

- **Primary:** gemini-cli (per rules/research-must-use-gemini-cli.md)
- **Selected for this run:** gemini-cli — long-context, cheap-token site extraction against the user's paid Gemini subscription; user explicitly requested gemini-cli for this run
- **Fallback if gemini-cli fails:** Claude in-session via WebFetch loop (only on recorded mid-run gemini failure)
- **Dispatch mechanics:** `research/scripts/dispatch-gemini.mjs` invoked once per slice file (6 slices under `scratch/eic-slices/`), because a single 64-URL dispatch exceeds the 10-minute foreground CLI budget (memory: feedback_long_cli_bash_timeout). The union of slice checklists equals the checklist below; coverage-check.mjs validates against THIS file.
- **Mid-run primary failure (recorded, fallback reason #4):** extraction itself completed 64/64 via gemini-cli, but the `synthesize-meaning.mjs` step failed twice with `gemini exit null` — the ~275KB input package (10 detail files incl. 212KB faq-verbatim-2026.md) embedded in a single `-p` argv exceeds Linux MAX_ARG_STRLEN (131072 bytes), so the spawn is killed before gemini starts. `details/applied-knowledge.md` was therefore synthesized by Claude in-session (fallback), from the same detail files. Framework gap: synthesize-meaning should pipe the package via stdin or a temp file.

## Volume estimate

- Sitemap URLs found (full site): 1718
- Scoped checklist for this extraction: 64 URLs (see Scoping decision)
- robots.txt fetched: yes; sitemap.xml fetched: yes; homepage fetched: yes
- Imprint patterns: none (EU institutional site — no EIK/BULSTAT expected; identity is the European Commission / EISMEA)

## Scoping decision (1718 → 64)

Goal of this run (user request): **every EIC funding program, timeline/cut-off, eligibility requirement, application process stage, funding amounts.** The sitemap enumerates the whole EIC site; the following categories are EXCLUDED as out of scope for that goal:

- `news/*` (392 URLs) — recency covered separately by the activity scorecard (blog-crawl.mjs)
- `events/*` (176) — event listings, not program knowledge
- `eic-fund/*` (323) — mostly portfolio-company profile pages; EIC Fund mechanics are covered by `faqs-eic-investments_en` + Accelerator pages on the checklist
- `success-stories/*` (36), `eic-summit-*` (58), `impact/*` (49) — marketing/retrospective content
- `eic-prizes/*` detail/edition/winner pages (~67) — prize hub + the startup-relevant Women Innovators prize ARE on the checklist; per-edition winner pages are not program knowledge
- legacy closed calls under `calls-proposals/*` (H2020 pilots, FET-Open/Proactive, Horizon Prizes, cascade-funding calls, ~30) — superseded programs; the live `calls-proposals_en` hub page IS on the checklist and records their closed status
- root-level portfolio company pages (e.g. `3dprintoptixmarket_en`) and misc one-off statements
- `bas/contacts_en`, `bas/contracts_en`, coach-recruitment sub-pages — operational pages for suppliers/coaches, not startup-facing program knowledge

**Coverage-verification amendment (2026-06-07, post-run):** an independent sitemap re-derivation found two ROOT-LEVEL FAQ pages outside the `/eic-frequently-asked-questions/` tree that the original Tier D missed: the Accelerator application-platform FAQ and the EIC Fund Trusted Investor Network charter FAQ. Both extracted into `details/application-platform-and-tin-faqs.md` and added to the checklist (66 total). Remaining residuals reviewed and held excluded: BAS sub-FAQs (tech-market, women-leadership — hub pages covered), coaching handbook (coach-facing), spin4eic toolkit, archived FAQ page (superseded), EIE consortium calls (closed; hub records status), Pathfinder Challenges 2022 (superseded edition). Known depth limit: HTML pages only — the Work Programme 2026 PDF and per-program annex documents are linked from covered pages but not themselves deep-extracted.

## Extraction plan

Domain: `references/knowledge/domains/eic-accelerator/` (new — sibling of `domains/eit-urban-mobility`; EIC ≠ EIT, distinct EU bodies/programs).

Planned detail files (Layer 3, each with Mechanism + Analysis + L4 pointers):

- `details/accelerator-program.md` — grant/equity amounts, blended finance, Open vs Challenges, TRL expectations, company eligibility
- `details/application-process.md` — short proposal → full proposal → interview stages, cut-off dates, resubmission rules, Fast Track / Plug schemes, Seal of Excellence
- `details/accelerator-challenges-2025-2026.md` — per-challenge scope verbatim summaries
- `details/other-programs.md` — Pathfinder (Open + Challenges), Transition, Pre-accelerator, STEP Scale-up, Advanced Innovation Challenges pilot: budgets, deadlines, eligibility, TRL ranges
- `details/eic-fund-investments.md` — EIC Fund mechanics from investments FAQ (equity terms, ownership, decision process)
- `details/business-acceleration-services.md` — BAS programme catalog
- `details/eligibility-and-rules.md` — general conditions, country eligibility, lump-sum budgets, IP provisions
- `details/blog-recent.md` — last-12-months activity (via blog-crawl.mjs)
- `details/applied-knowledge.md` — synthesis (via synthesize-meaning.mjs) incl. cross-reference to existing `domains/eit-urban-mobility` knowledge
